sources.title: Shreshth Saini
sources.snippet: This study investigates the exploitation of diffusion model priors to achieve perceptual consistency in image quality assessment. By leveraging the inherent priors learned by diffusion models, the assessment of image quality is made more aligned with human perception, leading to more accurate and reliable evaluations.
